newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Flughafen tailspin on results continues.
newsitem.headline: Flughafen tailspin on results continues.

text.p: Shares of Vienna airport company Flughafen Wien continued their free fall on Friday, shedding 8.3 percent in early trade as investors continued to dump the stock after Thursday's first-half-earnings shock.
"This isn't over yet," said a trader. "I would hold back with any buy orders."
Flughafen on Thursday posted a 5.4 percent drop in first-half net profit to 263 million and warned its full-year earnings would remain below last year's.
The shares were down 50.6 schillings at 558.0 at 0805 GMT, the leading decliner on the Vienna bourse. The blue-chip ATX index was down 5.56 points or 0.55 percent at the same time.
Traders traced a number of large sell orders to international investors. Market participants expect the share to continue its tailspin to as low as 500 schillings.
"Then we'll see some demand coming in," said one. "But right now nobody wants to get their fingers burned." -- Knut Engelmann, Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
